caption:
Founding a town of AI cats 🐾

A new town opens: the Mayor flies in, says hello, asks what the town should do, then shows you around.

Live capture of the Cat Town app's own intro, recorded frame by frame on a controlled clock. The recorder sends no inputs; the camera moves are the app's built-in cinematic. Parts of the intro are sped up or slowed to fit 15 s, and a few still moments get a slow zoom in the edit. Made with AI and code.
